title: Form action set to a javascript URL

remediation: Point the action at a server route and handle validation there.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches the form element with a javascript action; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.
scopeT: A response body that carries a form whose action is a javascript: URL.
fp: A page that documents the scheme in prose is not reported.
recordDesc: A form whose action is a javascript: URL in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Submitting the form executes the URL as script in the page's origin, and any value the form posts is available to that script.
applicability: Deployments that render a form whose action is a javascript: URL into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Submitting the form executes the URL as script in the page's origin, and any value the form posts is available to that script.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Point the action at a server route and handle validation there.

verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a form whose action is a javascript: URL.
